title: Write Multiple Registers exchange
purpose: Exercise a variable-length FC10 write request followed by its structurally matching normal acknowledgment.
expected_behavior: The server may acknowledge writing two registers at address 0100 by echoing the starting address and quantity with the same transaction identifier.
constraints_preserved: request MBAP length 000b matches unit plus FC10 PDU
response MBAP length 0006 matches unit plus five-byte acknowledgment PDU
transaction identifier is preserved across the exchange
issue_safety_notes: The exchange is included for parser and response-shape coverage only; behavior is model-prior plausibility, not externally verified, and no vulnerability relevance is implied.
